links.comparator_used: MedJev's uncalibrated zero-shot probabilities on patient-level tasks
links.outcome: Calibration (expected calibration error, ECE) of patient-level predictions
links.effect: Patient-level predictions were substantially miscalibrated (In Hospital Mortality ECE 0.286); the two-parameter recalibration reduced ECE to 0.007.
links.tradeoff: Needs 50 to 200 labeled local examples for recalibration.
links.quote: We introduce a lightweight, two parameter recalibration method that adapts predictions to local patient populations using 50 to 200 labeled examples, reducing ECE to 0.007.
